opening.argument: The video presents cryptocurrency earnings as unusually accessible: its title advertises “MAKE $5000/TRADE,” while the speaker claims, “We earned $1,000 in one round with such a simple method.” Viewers are instructed to deposit Ethereum, trade the full amount on Biftex, and “Try it yourself according to this scheme.” The process then calls for a USDT withdrawal involving a network fee, but the displayed withdrawal remains pending. The available material does not verify the exchange, the shown balance, completion of the withdrawal, or whether the claimed returns were genuine.
